L11: # Ratepayer Protection Act is Blocked in Senate
L12: 
L13: September 18, 2026
L14: 
L15: After it passed the House of Representatives, Senator Jon Husted (R-OH) attempted to pass H.R. 9340, the Ratepayer Protection Act, in the Senate on Sept. 17 via unanimous consent.
L16: 
L17: But it failed on the floor after Senate Energy & Natural Resources Committee Ranking Member Martin Heinrich (D-NM) objected, arguing it did not go far enough to force data centers to protect existing customers from rate increases.
L18: Republicans had hoped to pass the bill ahead of the midterm elections. While the bill, sponsored by Reps. Gabe Evans (R-CO) and Kathy Castor (D-FL), received strong bipartisan support in the House, Democrats in both the House and Senate have highlighted that it imposes a voluntary standard and said it is only a starting point for data center policies.
